title: Introduction to Lua
subtopics: What Lua is and what makes it distinct
Lua as a general-purpose and embeddable language
learning_outcomes: Describe Lua as a lightweight, dynamically typed language designed for extension and embedding.
Identify several areas where Lua is used and explain the role of the host application.
Run a small Lua script and distinguish source code from runtime behavior.

content.intro: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. Its small core makes it useful for extending software, but a host may expose only a selected set of APIs.
content.why_it_matters: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. Its small core makes it useful for extending software, but a host may expose only a selected set of APIs. items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Introduction to Lua with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
